newsitem.title: USA: DeKalb Genetics wins corn hybrid approval.
newsitem.headline: DeKalb Genetics wins corn hybrid approval.

text.p: DeKalb Genetics Corp said Tuesday it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its insect-resistant corn hybrids in time for the spring planting season.
DeKalb said the so-called Bt seeds contain a protein that protects the seeds from the European corn borer, a pest that costs U.S. farmers up to $1 billion in lost yields annually.
The Bt trait is available in three of DeKalb's hybrid seed lines, the company said.
DeKalb is an agricultural genetics and biotechnology research company.
Its shares closed up 1-3/8 Tuesday at 55.
